title: Restore browser-local admin home section ordering and validate its action boundary

source.ref: Actual /admin janitor home mounts the restored organizer; existing cookie-first SSR ordering remains

detail: The home dashboard still read and rendered its saved section-order cookie, but no runtime caller could save a new order. Restored native Up/Down controls and explicit Save in the active Frequency janitor home, using the existing scope registry and server action with shared Button styling. Preserves every section, browser-local persistence and first-server-render ordering. Pending controls prevent duplicate saves, failures recover with generic retry feedback, and success refreshes the server-rendered section order. The server action retains requireAdminFloor and now parses runtime scope/order arguments before cookie access: prototype names, malformed list members and oversized payloads are rejected; known IDs are sanitized/deduplicated and missing sections append. Removed only this repaired action from the frozen parse-input residual. Domain organizers are not claimed restored: only home currently consumes saved order. No production interactions or new data/schema writes.

verify.evidence: 12 focused rendered/action tests pass: native ordering/bounds/full section list, actual action payload, pending disable, safe error recovery, actual janitor mount and SSR reader/map, authorization refusal, forged runtime arguments, cookie sanitization and failed write without success revalidation. Focused lint, parse-input guard and diff checks pass. Source plus mocked rendered/action evidence only; authenticated browser/deployment acceptance remains in the app-wide acceptance rows.
